cv.title: Senior Analyst | Quantitative Analytics & Modeling
summary: Senior analytics professional with experience across business intelligence, analytics engineering, and growth analytics. Strong background in statistical analysis, SQL, and Python automation, with hands-on delivery of forecasting, attribution, segmentation, and analytical tools that translate complex business questions into practical decisions.

bullets: Engineer and maintain transformation workflows across landing, intermediate, and reporting data layers in Snowflake, centralizing analytical business logic and calculations.
Maintain Apache Airflow DAGs and version-controlled GitLab workflows, using Cursor and reusable development skills to support continuous documentation.
Contribute to a YAML-based data quality framework covering approximately 80 Snowflake tables, owning validation tests across funnel metrics, sales channels, and conversion paths.
Develop SQL checks for source reconciliation, business-logic accuracy, and join-key consistency to detect defects before dashboard consumption.
Developing a Snowflake Model Context Protocol (MCP) integration and semantic context definitions to enable LLM-driven analytical SQL generation.
Developing an in-house analytics and dashboarding prototype powered by Claude and semantic context layers.

projects.name: Traffic Source & Customer Journey Attribution
bullets: Designed incremental event- and journey-grain enrichment pipelines for traffic-source and first-touch context, with a declarative classification taxonomy.
Validated enrichment pipelines against production and released across intermediate and reporting layers with controlled backfills and no breaking changes to existing reporting.
Conducted peer benchmark and performance-gap decomposition across 72 customer brands, providing actionable recommendations adopted by all customer success managers.
Owned end-to-end marketing analytics for a subscription-based mobile app across 51 cities.
Partnered with marketing leadership to model budget scenarios and project CAC, ROAS, and subscriber growth, supporting €200k–€500k in monthly marketing spend.
Delivered Power BI reporting models and dbt transformations in Snowflake to track customer funnels and conversion metrics.

projects.name: City Demand Forecasting & Scenario Modeling
bullets: Built a quantitative demand forecasting model linking marketing investments to subscriber adoption across 51 cities, improving quarterly planning precision by ~20% over prior heuristics.
Evaluated demand saturation and payback timelines to inform city launches and budget allocations, contributing to an 8–10% ROAS uplift.
Developed scalable analytics pipelines and data models in BigQuery and dbt to unify user behavioral data, transactional investment records, and campaign performance.
Designed a Markov-chain attribution model integrating paid, CRM, and offline sources, informing a 30% spend shift from Facebook to Google Ads and an 8% blended CAC reduction.
Supported investor and revenue reporting for a platform with multi-million-euro annual investment volume; automated voucher and cashback calculations and SEPA-compatible payment files using Python.

projects.name: Conversational LLM Database Query Prototype
bullets: Built a conversational analytics tool using OpenAI’s GPT API to generate and execute SQL on BigQuery, enabling non-technical stakeholders to access investor, marketing, and revenue insights.

projects.name: Investor Segmentation & Behavioral Clustering
bullets: Applied K-means clustering to investor behavioral and investment data, enabling retention strategies that increased repeat investment by 7% and reduced monthly churn by approximately 4%.
Delivered cross-functional analytics across Marketing, Product, and Sales to support revenue growth in an automotive marketplace.
Supported A/B testing and experimentation on product and search features, improving funnel performance and conversion rates.
Built and maintained core executive reporting suites in Looker, improving visibility into multi-channel acquisition funnels.

projects.name: Multi-Touch Attribution Modeling
bullets: Formulated a position-based attribution framework using session-level clickstream data, directing quarterly spend reallocation that produced a 6–8% increase in qualified leads.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Data & Analytics Senior Analyst position at Oliver Wyman in Amsterdam. The opportunity to develop and evaluate analytical solutions for varied client challenges appeals to me. My dual engineering degree from IIT Madras and MScBA from Rotterdam School of Management support a background spanning quantitative analysis, business intelligence, and analytics engineering. I offer experience translating ambiguous business questions into models, analytical tools, and practical recommendations.

At Aklamio, I led a traffic-source and customer-journey attribution initiative from incremental Snowflake pipelines to GoodData dashboards and customer recommendations. I analyzed 72 brands using leave-one-out peer benchmarks and decomposed performance gaps into mix, efficiency, and interaction effects. The resulting insights are used by all customer success managers to guide client channel setups. I also contribute to a quality framework covering approximately 80 tables, owning funnel and sales-channel checks that validate business logic and reconcile derived values with source data.

Previously, at NeoTaste, I built demand forecasting models and scenario dashboards across 51 cities, improving planning accuracy by approximately 20% and supporting budget allocations that contributed to an 8–10% ROAS uplift. At ecoligo, I applied K-means investor segmentation and Markov-chain attribution, developed an OpenAI-powered BigQuery query tool, and automated payment calculations using Python. At heycar, I supported product experimentation and maintained Looker dashboards. These experiences provide a foundation for developing analytical solutions, assessing their effectiveness, and explaining findings clearly to technical and business stakeholders.

I would welcome the opportunity to contribute this combination of quantitative reasoning, practical delivery, and stakeholder communication to your Data & Analytics team. I hold a valid EU Blue Card issued by Germany and would require employer support for the appropriate work authorization in the Netherlands. I look forward to discussing how my experience can support Oliver Wyman’s client work.
